fields.Name: W7 -> C1.4
fields.Description: Gate G4.7 (owner PR 5, phase 4, dataset W7, criterion C1.4): the deterministic small-n refusal fires on W7-small-imbalanced s42 on 3 of 3 runs. The gate loads W7 s42 (the suite's dataset load leaves W7 at its fresh seed), then runs the Model Development Agent on MJAPI three times from a complete plan on the W7 membership years: each session ends with a decline-small-data decision row carrying the profile's counts (fewer than 200 resolved or 50 minority development rows), its profile row read 0 holdout rows, no plan is presented and nothing is built. Client transport (no approval is involved); must follow the agent suite's server-transport tests (#3251). Spends LLM money (one orchestrator prompt per run). Mutation (unit attack 1): '<' -> '<=' on either threshold -> red. Run budget 15 min (MaxExecutionTimeMS): the W7 load and three short runs.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Three W7 s42 sessions each end decline-small-data with the counts on the decision row, no plan presented and no build.
